category_results.purpose: Collect warehouse usage, configuration, and lifecycle events.
category_results.required_permission: SELECT on billing and compute system tables

category_results.required_permission: SELECT on billing and access/network system tables

category_results.required_permission: SELECT on identity-bearing billing and workload tables

category_results.purpose: Collect custom tags, granular tags, and allocation metadata.
category_results.required_permission: SELECT on billing, compute, and Lakeflow system tables

category_results.purpose: Collect cost-control references such as budget policy identifiers exposed in usage metadata.
